capture_note: STATIC SEED, NOT A PROFILE. No hardware capture exists yet, so 'top 15 of a captured profile' is not in force and the corpus age clock is dormant while provisional is true. gates_vfp prints a loud note while this flag is set. To promote: take a real capture, write it to docs/validation/perf-YYYY-MM-DD-*.log, set provisional=false and captured to the capture date, and re-derive this seed from the profile -- the seed is a starting scope, never a substitute for the measurement.
